summary: Lexaria Bioscience Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that its wholly-owned Australian subsidiary received an AUD$3,666,611.98 (USD$2.6M) tax credit from the Australian Tax Office for R&D costs related to its GLP-1-H24-4 clinical study. The funds were deposited for future Australian R&D. This is a routine operational event, not a special situation. No deal terms, transactions, or strategic actions are involved.
